hints.title: Greedy Subarray Search
hints.text: Always match each group at the earliest possible starting index in nums.

hints.title: Advance Pointer Beyond Match
hints.text: Once group i is matched in nums[j..j + len - 1], advance search index to j + len to keep subarrays disjoint.

hints.title: Check All Groups Matched
hints.text: If all groups are found in sequential order before running out of nums, return true; otherwise false.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: L is maximum length of any group
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backtracking over all possible placements is unnecessary because first match is always optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy linear scanning evaluates subsegment matches in O(n * L) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate explains why greedy earliest matching does not miss any valid solution.
